title: invoice.rectify payload
description: Issues a rectifying invoice (R1) that negates an existing invoice in full. The server dates it on the business day and numbers it in that year's RECT series (invoice#79): a rectifying invoice is dated the day it is issued. `issue_date` and `year` are accepted only so a caller that sends them gets a clear refusal (`invoice.rectify_date_not_allowed`) instead of a document silently dated on another day — omit them.

original_id.description: Id of the invoice being rectified.

reason.description: Why it is rectified; it is printed on the document.

issue_date.description: Do not send it. If sent, it must be the business's today (YYYY-MM-DD), or the request is refused.

year.description: Do not send it. If sent, it must be the business's current year, or the request is refused.
